fade_in_hero.css: @keyframes fade_in_hero { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(20px); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } .hero, .hero h1, .hero p { animation: fade_in_hero 1.6s ease-out both; }

scroll_reveal_cards.css: @keyframes scroll_reveal_cards { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } } .card, .class-card, .teacher-card { animation: scroll_reveal_cards 1s ease-out both; }

soft_hover_image_zoom.css: .img-zoom { overflow: hidden; } .img-zoom img { transition: transform 1.2s ease; } .img-zoom:hover img { transform: scale(1.05); }

breath_pulse.css: @keyframes breath_pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.85; } 50% { opacity: 1; } } .breath { animation: breath_pulse 4s ease-in-out infinite; }

home.layout: Full-bleed hero photo with thin serif headline center-left, followed by three-column class type cards, a horizontal weekly schedule preview, single teacher spotlight with portrait, and a quiet membership banner.

schedule.layout: Day-tab navigation atop a clean 7-column calendar grid with class cards stacked by time; left sidebar holds filters for style, teacher, and virtual toggle.

teachers.layout: Asymmetric editorial grid of portrait cards alternating left/right with name in italic, certifications below, and expandable bio panel.

workshops.layout: Vertical stack of full-width event blocks with large imagery on alternating sides, title in serif, date/location meta line, and gentle 'Investment' price with reserve button.

about.layout: Long-form narrative single-column with oversized serif pull quotes, full-bleed studio photo interludes, testimonial carousel, and final FAQ accordion.
